---
title: "Embla"
subtitle: "Review Plotly outputs"
---

This site is the review surface for Plotly figures and `go.Table`. It follows
the same local reading pattern as Askr, the Quarto reading page, and it only
carries Plotly outputs.

Embla owns appearance, interaction, and output settings. Consumer work owns
the scientific data, units, normalization, axis ranges, and domain calculations.
The Python API, profile names, packaging, and failure behavior are still
**CONVERGING** and are not accepted here.

## What to review

The [Outputs](outputs/index.qmd) pages use synthetic traces from standard
qubit formulas, so the figure chrome can be judged on a realistic diagram:

- lines, for a color sequence and overlapping curves
- bars and markers, for a short comparison and semantic colors
- heatmaps, for a continuous scale and a diverging scale
- a table, for header and cell text
- theme anchors, for the slide background as paper and the slide surface as the plot area, in light and dark

Each of the first four pages shows a screen reading and a print reading. The page's light or dark mode selects the matching figure.
